text:
alex: Hey folks — quick sync on the Pioneer RFI thread. I uploaded a draft capability_matrix.csv, rfi_answers.pdf, and poc_sow.md to the deal folder: https://drive.company/pioneer-rfi. Buyer questions we need to finalize: on-prem HSM support, guaranteed POC throughput numbers, peering/topology options, and a clear pricing tier for the enterprise commitment. Can ops + security + pricing please review and confirm by EOD Friday?

mira: I'll take the capability matrix and validate feature parity with our Dedicated vs Private docs. Quick note — streaming + function-calling are in hosted; need to call out latency SLOs for Dedicated.

jamal: On HSM/KMS — short answer for the RFI: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS and HSM (BYO-HSM) with an audited integration path; hosted can integrate with cloud KMS only and does not expose raw key material." I'll draft a short paragraph for rfi_answers.pdf. Also flag: FedRAMP/IL compliance question — we should call out what controls we map to.

sam: Ops note: POC throughput depends on model family + batch config. For baseline numbers we can quote: `gptx-13b: 400 reqs/s (16-token avg) on 4xA100, burst 700 reqs/s for 5m`; `gptx-70b: 85 reqs/s (16-token avg) on 8xA100 equivalent`. Those are conservative — fine to include as "expected POC throughput with recommended instance sizing". I'll attach a tiny CSV with these numbers.

lee: Sales ask — buyer wants price bands for 10k, 100k, 1M tokens / mo and a dedicated POC month price. Can finance give a quick delta for dedicated vs hosted? Also they asked about data residency in eu-west-1.

jamal: Data residency: we can promise EU-only region for Private and Dedicated via routing policy, but must include note about logs/console access (control plane may sit in us-east unless customer requests private control plane — that's a separate enterprise option). I'll add that sentence.

mira: Two small content asks: 1) mark any matrix rows that are "technical caveats" (quantization impact on accuracy, client-side PKI for HSM). 2) Add a line explaining our fallback behavior: if dedicated capacity saturated we route to compatible lower-cost variant — which affects SLA.

alex: @sam can you drop that CSV snippet here? @jamal @mira I'll stitch your paragraphs into rfi_answers.pdf once you drop them. We need one unified answer, not three slightly different statements.

sales-bot: Reminder: Pioneer RFI deadline set to 2025-02-14 17:00 UTC. Upload new attachments to /deals/pioneer/rfi to ensure versioning.

sam: CSV snippet (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_per_s,burst_reqs_per_s,notes
gptx-13b,4xA100,400,700,16 token avg, continous batch
gptx-70b,8xA100,85,160,16 token avg, large-context optimizations
embedding-s-1,2xA100,1200,2000,embedding-only workload
```

mira: I reviewed capabilities. Differences to call out in matrix: Dedicated has configurable autoscale + SLA; Private adds BYO-HSM + private control plane option; hosted has simplest onboarding and streaming. I'll annotate the CSV.

jamal: Draft RFI HSM paragraph (paste):

"Private deployments: support customer-managed HSMs via standard PKCS11/NSS interfaces. We provide an integration guide and recommended attestation steps; customer is responsible for HSM key lifecycle. Dedicated: supports cloud KMS integration with customer-managed keys in supported clouds. Hosted: integrates with cloud KMS only; we do not store customer key material. For customers requiring FIPS 140-2/3 validated HSMs, Private deployment is recommended."

lee: This looks good. Two blockers the buyer flagged: 1) legal needs egress liability language (they want a cap), 2) SRE wants a runbook for post-POC scale. Who owns the runbook?

sam: Ops can produce a 1-2 page runbook for POC scale and handover. I'll volunteer to draft it and include run commands for autoscale toggles and warmup steps.

alex: Action items summary: 
- jamal: finalize security paragraph and FedRAMP mapping (due Thu EOD)
- sam: finalize throughput CSV + poc runbook draft (due Thu EOD)
- mira: annotate capability_matrix.csv with caveats and fallback behavior (due Thu noon)
- lee: request pricing bands from finance for 10k/100k/1M tokens + dedicated POC month price (due Thu EOD)
Alex: I'll assemble rfi_answers.pdf and re-upload to the drive, then we do one internal sign-off thread before sending it to the buyer.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll add inline comments in the CSV.

jamal: noted, will ping compliance for FedRAMP mapping.

lee: TY team — I'll book a 30m sync tomorrow 10am to do final read-through.

alex: perfect. If anything blocks, post here.
